scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,passenger,driver -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev -w @ride-app/api" "npm run dev -w @ride-app/passenger" "npm run dev -w @ride-app/driver"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ride-app/shared && npm run build -w @ride-app/api && npm run build -w @ride-app/passenger && npm run build -w @ride-app/driver
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs
scripts.health: curl -sf http://localhost:4001/health && echo ' API ok' && curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:5174 && echo ' Passenger ok' && curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:5175 && echo ' Driver ok'
